reference: PLAN: 1. Find information about Peter and the Wolf (1946 film). 2. Identify which animated anthology it was released as a segment of and its release date.

descendants_plus.hop_2: FINDING: Peter and the Wolf (1946 film) was originally released as a segment of an animated anthology titled "Make Mine Music" on April 20, 1946.

corruptions.text: PLAN: First hop: Identify which company changed the name from Lynx Software Technologies. Second hop: Find out when and where these buildings were named after changing their names.

descendants.hop_2:
PLAN: First hop: Identify which company changed the name from Lynx Software Technologies. Second hop: Find out when and where these buildings were named after changing their names.

Finding: The company that changed the name from Lynx Software Technologies to Lynx Entertainment was Sony Pictures Television, Inc., formerly known as Sony Pictures Home Entertainment (SPHE). This change occurred in 2014, marking a significant shift in the entertainment industry.
